image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a white baby bib with a green tropical leaf pattern (monstera/palm). The bib features a white crocheted or lace trim along the curved edges and neck opening. A white fabric tie is visible at the top center for fastening. The material appears to be a soft fabric, likely cotton or a blend, rather than rigid plastic.

The tie on the left side appears to merge somewhat indistinctly with the background and the lace trim, lacking a clear termination point or knot structure compared to the clearer top tie.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and distinguish it from other apparel like aprons or doilies.
AI often struggles with complex, repetitive boundaries like crochet/lace. This expert will check if the trim is a continuous, physically connected loop or if it melts into the fabric/background.
To analyze the micro-texture of the fabric and print for signs of AI-generated noise or unnatural smoothness.

focus_areas: Continuity and physical plausibility of the white lace/crochet trim.
Clarity and structural integrity of the fabric ties.
Consistency of the leaf pattern (no morphing or melting shapes).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the lace trim. In AI images, lace often becomes a blurry mess or fuses with the background. Verify if the holes in the lace are distinct and if the trim maintains a consistent width. Also, check the left-side tie; does it look like a real piece of fabric tied or hanging, or does it dissolve into the dark background?
